content: In a building consisting primarily of one storey, no more than 200 m2 of fire-compartmented and no more than 50 m2 of non-fire-compartmented areas that essentially relate to the business of the building may be located on the level of second storey.
question: What is the maximum area of non-fire-compartmented areas that essentially relate to the business of the building that may be located on the second storey of a building consisting primarily of one storey?
